summary: Implemented contextual pre-dispatch specification assurance in the canonical compiled-dispatch contract helper. The durable record separates literal request, observable outcome, non-goals and human-recognizable success; emits no questions for a sufficiently specified trivial case; emits high-information-gain blocking questions only for material ambiguity/risk signals; records resolutions and reconstruction without private chat history; and validates unresolved specification questions fail-closed when the specification_assurance section is present. Added adversarial coverage for literal-vs-outcome conflict, metric gaming, omitted owner/reuse, incomplete human verification, foreseeable future conditions, granularity/parallelism uncertainty and missing verification evidence.
